summary: Removed the vo2-max command/resource entirely (spec, generated command file, sync/tail/workflow/MCP registrations, and docs).
reason: A publish-time live smoke test (real OURA_ACCESS_TOKEN) showed /v2/usercollection/vo2_max returns HTTP 404 on every request, confirmed independently via curl and a direct WebFetch probe. The endpoint does not exist on Oura's live v2 API, so the originally-spec'd resource was a research-time error rather than a real reachable endpoint; shipping it would mean a command that always fails.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test pass after removal; sync against the live API now reports 0 errored resources for resources backed by real endpoints (webhook-subscription separately requires client-credential auth, unrelated to this fix).
